text.p: Mobilemedia Corp and 18 affiliates Thursday filed for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware, according to court papers.

Last month the company said it would have to file for Chapter 11 if it could not "reach accomodations" with suppliers and creditors. "In the event of a Chapter 11 filing the company believes that it will enter into a debtor-in-possession credit agreement... to sustain its business operations."
In December Mobilemedia said it defaulted on an interest payment on its 9-3/8 percent senior subordinated notes due November 1, 2007.
Mobilemedia Corp of Richfield Park, N.J., is the second largest provider of paging and other wireless messaging services in the U.S.
No other information on the bankruptcy filing is available at this time.
